postTitle: ⚡️ useMemo: Don’t Recompute Everything in React
postContent: ⚡️ Hook: useMemo caches the result of a pure calculation. It prevents expensive work from re-running on every render. 🧠 It re-computes only when its dependencies change. Place it at the top level of your component. Don’t put it inside loops or conditionals. 🔧 Use it for expensive filters, sorts, or deriving data from large lists. Pattern to remember: const result = useMemo(() => heavyCompute(input), [input]).

tehnicalChallange.title: Challenge: Refactor a component to use useMemo
tehnicalChallange.description: Take a component that derives a list from props with a heavy computation. Refactor to use useMemo and ensure the dependencies are correct so it only recomputes when inputs change.
